scope: Three selected editorial diagrams for Exodus 7:8–13 and 8:16–24. The cards show only their sourced nodes and do not establish full chapter coverage.

assets.authoringmethod: Native SVG text, cards, labels, and green sequence arrows; no ImageGen or raster imagery.
assets.exact_alt_text: Three cards show Exodus 7:10–12 in order: Aaron casts down his rod, the Egyptian magicians cast down theirs, and Aaron’s rod swallows theirs. Green arrows mark the sequence; the events are not shown as one instant.

assets.authoringmethod: Native SVG text, cards, labels, and green sequence arrows; no ImageGen or raster imagery.
assets.exact_alt_text: Three cards follow Exodus 8:17–19: dust becomes lice after Aaron strikes it, the magicians cannot reproduce the sign, then they attribute it to God’s power. Green arrows mark the sequence. Their speech is shown as text; no hand is depicted.

assets.references: Exodus 8:20–24 · narrated outcome and announced distinction

assets.exact_alt_text: Two text panels compare Exodus 8:20–24: verse 24 reports swarms in Pharaoh’s and his servants’ houses and in Egypt; verses 22–23 announce a distinction for Goshen. The panels show neither a map nor a separately observed Goshen outcome.
